alt: Two box plots stacked on one shared number line of test scores running from 50 to 100, marked every 5. Class 1 is the upper plot: minimum 60, lower quartile 70, median 74, upper quartile 82, maximum 96. Class 2 is the lower plot: minimum 58, lower quartile 72, median 80, upper quartile 86, maximum 94. Both classes have a range of 36, but Class 2's box is wider and sits further right.
